name: quality-loop
description: A quality loop for AI-assisted development in four layers: skeptical exploratory QA of plans and code (surfaces non-obvious decisions, resolves technical findings, escalates product ones), a contract-driven testing discipline at unit and integration level (tests assert what the code promises, never how it works — unit suites verified by mutation testing, integration suites by provoked real-infrastructure failures), a deterministic pre-PR gate running your local Semgrep CE install with your project's own rules, and critical triage of Greptile AI code reviews — closed by a human-approved ratchet that turns recurring findings into rules. Works with your own Semgrep install and Greptile account; ships no vendor code and no rules.
